page.overview:
Who is Anstak?

Anstak was a male Jedi Master of an aquatic species. According to the Qel-Droma Epics, Anstak was in charge of a temple within the Imhar Canyon on the Jedi Order planet of Ossus. The temple was situated in a system of submerged tunnels, where Anstak trained numerous aquatic Jedi Padawans. Anstak kept a number of Force artifacts, often related to underwater endeavors. According to the Epics, Ossus was devastated by the Cron Supernovae, but some believed Anstak and his students could have survived within the deep caverns.
